review_evidence.exact_master: Reviewed 33 exact decoded five-second samples at 390 pixels and 11 targeted samples around balloon exit, stent delivery and drug-coated balloon contact/withdrawal. review_evidence.clinical: The opening shows the seated mesh staying behind after balloon withdrawal. The later sequence separates folded balloon and mounted mesh advancing together over a guidewire, centered inflation, deflation and withdrawal. Local coating release is shown near the wall. The balloon-only demonstration separately shows surface transfer and withdrawal without new metal. Simulated contrast, selected intravascular imaging and antiplatelet follow-up are separate educational views.
